assessments.reasoning: The survey uses 'jefe o jefa del hogar' / 'Jefe/a' to designate the anchor person rather than a gender-neutral term such as householder or reference person (so neutral_anchor_term is false). The questionnaire asks '¿Quién es el jefe o jefa del hogar?' without stating an explicit selection rule or criterion for choosing who is designated as head (so explicit_selection_rule and rule_not_sex_age_authority are false). The respondent to household-level questions is recorded separately in a dedicated 'Respondente' field in Block I of the household questionnaire, distinct from the reference person (so respondent_separate_or_any_adult is true).
